scan.pinterest_status: Pinterest's official Newsroom, Beauty Guides, Q5 creative-reset guidance, holiday optimization guidance and public Pinterest inspiration were checked on 11 October 2026. The newest official trend report remained the 6 October Beauty Trend Report. A recently updated public 2026 design-trends board supplied a distinct, repeated retro-pop cluster—food/product illustration, vintage cartoon mascots, bold limited palettes, halftone/screen-print texture and packaging/poster/social applications—not specifically covered by the existing retro-tech command.
scan.chatgpt_status: Production v2.20.0 with 716 commands was read before modification. v2.21.0 adds exactly /retro-pop-branding, preserves all 716 prior commands, 42 categories, 40 executable bundle mappings, personal creative intelligence, settings and updater compatibility, and passed 18 regression checks. Repository bytes are verified; the version installed in the browser remains locally observable only after userscript reload.
trends: retro food and product illustration with simplified, expressive shapes
vintage cartoon mascot systems used as repeatable brand assets rather than isolated characters
bold limited palettes with halftone, screen-print texture, selective ink misregistration and paper wear
retro-pop systems translated consistently across packaging, labels, posters, stickers, menus, merchandise and social assets
street-art, neon, synthwave, Japanese pop-art and second-hand poster references appeared as adjacent inspiration signals
official Beauty, Q5 and holiday guidance remains active but is already represented by existing beauty, trend-translation, performance-ad and visual-search commands
commands_added: /retro-pop-branding — Build an original, consistency-controlled retro-pop mascot and illustration system for packaging, posters, merchandise and social campaigns.
skipped: No separate /pop-art, /vintage-mascot, /neon-cafe, /synthwave or /japanese-pop-art commands because one adaptable retro-pop brand-system command captures the durable creative behavior without style-alias churn
No additional Beauty Trend Report command because /beauty-trend-system already covers precise reference decoding and coordinated editorial, UGC and product-ad outputs
No Q5 or holiday command because /performance-creative-mix, /trend-to-brand, /visual-search-ready and existing product/social controls already cover the durable guidance
No command was derived from the inaccessible Polish Pinterest board URL
